name: Switch
summary: A binary setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped. The visible switch is drawn by the library; the control underneath it is a real checkbox.
summaryZh: 一拨就生效的二值设置。看得见的开关由库来画,底下的控件是一个真正的 checkbox。

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default track. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

states.name: Checked
states.note: The track fills with the brand colour and the thumb slides to the far end.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The track dims, and the label takes the derived disabled text colour.

states.name: Loading
states.note: The track dims and the pointer stops, because a switch that is busy cannot be flipped.

states.name: Inline prompt
states.note: The state is written inside the track instead of on a thumb beside it.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The real checkbox. It must come before the track: the checked state is matched with an adjacent sibling selector.

parts.name: Track
parts.note: The rounded groove the thumb travels in.

parts.name: Thumb
parts.note: The circle that moves. It is moved with a transform, so nothing around it reflows.

parts.name: Inner
parts.note: The text inside the track. It is only shown in the inline-prompt state, where it says which way the switch is set.

parts.name: Action
parts.note: The mark that sits beside the switch: what the switch will do. It is there in the markup either way, and it shows only when the caller has written something into it.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The text beside the switch. Optional, but a switch without one needs an accessible name of its own.

props.name: checked
props.description: Turns the setting on. It is the native checked attribute, not a class.
props.descriptionZh: 把设置打开。它是原生 checked 属性,不是某个类。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the switch inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让开关不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: name
props.description: The name the value is submitted under.
props.descriptionZh: 提交时这个值使用的名字。

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted while the switch is on.

props.name: model-value
props.description: The switch's own state, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `checked` prop is the state; bind it and the switch answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 开关自身的状态,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 checked 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the track and the thumb. The medium one is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 轨道和滑块的大小。中号就是基础类本身。

props.name: loading
props.description: Says the switch is busy. The track dims and the switch stops taking clicks.
props.descriptionZh: 表示开关正忙。轨道变暗,并且不再接受点击。

props.name: inline-prompt
props.description: Writes the state inside the track instead of on a thumb beside it. The active and inactive slots are what it writes.
props.descriptionZh: 把状态写在轨道里面,而不是写在外面的滑块上。写的是 active 与 inactive 两个插槽。

slots.name: active
slots.description: The text inside the track while the switch is on. It is shown in the inline-prompt state.
slots.descriptionZh: 开关打开时轨道里面的文字。在内嵌提示状态下显示。

slots.name: inactive
slots.description: The text inside the track while the switch is off. It is shown in the inline-prompt state.
slots.descriptionZh: 开关关闭时轨道里面的文字。在内嵌提示状态下显示。

slots.name: active-action
slots.description: The mark beside the switch while it is on: what the switch will do. It sits on the page rather than on the track, so it takes the body colour.
slots.descriptionZh: 开关打开时旁边那个标记:这个开关会做什么。它落在页面上而不是轨道里,所以用的是正文色。

slots.name: inactive-action
slots.description: The mark beside the switch while it is off: what the switch will do. It sits on the page rather than on the track, so it takes the body colour.
slots.descriptionZh: 开关关闭时旁边那个标记:这个开关会做什么。它落在页面上而不是轨道里,所以用的是正文色。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the switch is flipped. It is the browser's own event on the checkbox underneath — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 开关被拨动时触发。这是底下那个 checkbox 的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the switch is flipped, carrying the new state. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 开关被拨动时触发,携带新的状态。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

a11y.notes: The switch is a real <input type="checkbox"> inside a <label>, and the drawn parts are spans. The checked state is the browser's :checked, so the switch submits with the form, is announced as a checkbox and needs no JavaScript. The input is hidden visually rather than removed from the accessibility tree, so it keeps its place in the tab order and its label.
a11y.notesZh: 开关是 <label> 里一个真正的 <input type="checkbox">,画出来的部分都是 span。选中态就是浏览器的 :checked,所以它会随表单提交、被读屏播报成复选框,完全不需要 JavaScript。这个 input 只是视觉隐藏,没有被移出无障碍树,因此它仍在 Tab 顺序里,也仍然有标签。

examples.title: States
examples.description: On, off and locked. The state is the input's own checked attribute, so the markup a browser reads is the same one the stylesheet reads.
examples.descriptionZh: 打开、关闭和锁定。状态就是 input 自己的 checked 属性,所以浏览器读到的标记和样式表读到的状态是同一个。

examples.title: Without visible text
examples.description: The label element can be left out, but then the switch has no visible name and needs one for a screen reader. Put it on the input.
examples.descriptionZh: label 元素可以不写,但这样开关就没有可见的名字,读屏需要一个。写在 input 上。

notes: The track and the thumb are two nested spans, and the thumb moves with a transform rather than a position, so flipping the switch never moves anything around it. The disabled state dims the track with opacity and takes the derived disabled text colour for the label: a track has no text of its own, so only the shape can be dimmed.
notesZh: 轨道和滑块是两个套在一起的 span,滑块靠 transform 移动而不是靠定位,所以拨动开关不会带动周围任何东西。禁用态用 opacity 压暗轨道,文字标签换成派生出来的禁用色:轨道本身没有文字,能变淡的只有形状。
